cohort: Pregnant women aged 20-46 diagnosed with gestational diabetes after 24 weeks of pregnancy, who were treated at the Department of Pathology of Pregnancy, Clinical Centre Kragujevac.
finding: Timely detection and adequate treatment of gestational diabetes can prevent foetal macrosomia, which is a primary complication of these pregnancies.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was dominant, with episiotomy in almost half the cases, and gestational diabetes is not necessarily an indication for a Caesarean section.
gest_age: 70.7% delivered between 37th and 40th week of gestation
